title: .github/claude-review.yml
description: A mirror of validate_config in .github/workflows/claude-code-review.yml. tests/test-review-config-schema-drift.py fails when the two disagree. The workflow stays the authority.

extends.description: owner/repo[@ref]: that repository's .github/claude-review.yml is the shared layer under this one.

default_model.description: The model a round runs on unless an escalation path or a summon picks another.

level.description: Effort per unit of reviewed code, never which code is read.

admission.description: auto reviews every eligible PR; label only PRs carrying claude_review; off stops the lane.

auto_pause_rounds.description: Rounds on one PR before the lane pauses until someone summons it.

skip_authors.description: Logins whose PRs are never reviewed.

escalation_paths.description: Globs whose change moves a round to Opus.

path_filters.description: Globs the review reads; a leading ! excludes.

path_instructions.description: Extra review instructions for files matching a glob.

max_reviewable_lines.description: A PR with more changed lines is refused; 0 disables the cap.

max_file_lines.description: A file with more lines is skipped; 0 disables the check.

language_map.description: Bare extension (no dot) to language name.

tool_findings.description: Which of the catalog's static tools run and feed the review.

issue_context_byte_budget.description: Bytes of each linked issue the review reads.

issue_context_total_byte_budget.description: Bytes of linked issues the review reads in total.

variant.description: An experiment label for A/B comparison; empty is control.

context.description: Public repositories the review may read, at a fixed ref.

suppress_below.description: Findings below this severity are not posted.

enable_ai_fix_prompt.description: Each finding carries a prompt to fix it.

include_verification_note.description: Each finding says how it was verified.

share.description: What this repository sends to the telemetry Worker: full, rounds (no text) or off.
